title: Data sheet for aerial ropeways and cableways to be provided to intending purchaser and user, Part 1: Data to be supplied for aerial ropeways system for transportation of goods. surface
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11168 (PART 1)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Data sheet for aerial ropeways and cableways to be provided to intending purchaser and user, Part 1: Data to be supplied for aerial ropeways system for transportation of goods. surface.
clause_3_terminology: Data sheet for aerial ropeways and cableways to be provided to intending purchaser and user
Part 1: Data to be supplied for aerial ropeways system for transportation of goods. surface

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
